scope: Live end-to-end acceptance against an isolated app built from the candidate source and the deployed target container's credential snapshot. Every check is a real HTTP request over a real socket, because the change under test lives in the ASGI send path.
source_digest_method: sha256 over sorted <relpath>\u0000<committed blob bytes>\u0000 for src/**/*.py at the commit above. The final run shipped those committed bytes rather than the working tree, so the digest is reproducible: the earlier archive digest embedded file mtimes, and the earlier content digest was taken before a git autocrlf rewrite changed 80 working-tree files from LF to CRLF without changing any code.

client_level_runs.note: Recorded earlier in this same change with real CLI clients; NOT re-executed in the final API-level run above. The Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses protocols are covered API-level in every run.

transport_change.behavior: Each SSE body write has a 60 second deadline; every response exit closes the upstream iterator. The Responses continuation is committed only after the terminal body write is accepted, so a stalled downstream reader releases the request lock and leaves the parent id retryable.
transport_change.live_scope: All six protocol/provider matrix paths exercised streaming responses, including API-level tool loops on both client-compatible protocols and single-use enforcement of the Responses parent id.
transport_change.not_live_verified: A real socket stall is neither safe nor deterministic against the shared deployed target, so stalled-reader release is covered by targeted tests rather than by the live matrix.

environment_drift_observed.observation: The Consumer account's pinned proxy 204.76.203.9 refuses connections; the harness probes the pinned egress first and falls back, recording which egress carried the traffic.

A fallback proxy died mid-run (Camoufox reported NS_ERROR_PROXY_CONNECTION_REFUSED and every Consumer cell reported curl (7)), failing all Consumer cells in that run; the same code passed them before and after. The candidate egress list was widened to three measured-reachable exits.

Isolated runs also hit an upstream Consumer refusal (challenge with method=null, and a conversation-create HTTP 415 on the immediate repeat) while the other three Consumer protocol cells passed in the same run over the identical conversation-create code path.

Individual planner tool cells intermittently returned text instead of a tool call, or two tool calls instead of one. Each miss is recorded and the identical request is measured once more; the final run needed no repeats.

The isolated Camoufox preflight minted a fresh Consumer token in 12s on most runs but never minted inside 75s on one, which silently fell back to the stored credential (then ~7.7 days old) and failed every Consumer cell with HTTP 401 on conversation create. The preflight budget was widened to 240s/180s with one clean retry on a fresh profile copy.
The isolated harness refuses to start when the M365 token has under 600s left; the production credential was refreshed through the admin endpoint before each run.

interpretation: The final run shipped the committed bytes of the commit named above and passed every matrix cell with no repeats. Earlier misses in this change are retained above with their measured cause rather than rewritten as first-pass successes; every one was traced to egress, browser-mint, or upstream model drift, and none to the transport or continuation code under test.
